title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The roadmap facts, preview behaviour and documented control paths and commands are supported. The briefing distinguishes preview access from the unconfirmed general-availability default and does not invent an app entitlement from a tenant licensing prerequisite. The cost rationale should explicitly repeat that the app's licensing terms are not yet published.

claims.claim: Learn documents Business Analytics as a Frontier preview providing early access to Microsoft AI innovation.
claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program. Frontier connects you directly with Microsoft's latest AI innovations.

claims.quote: As these features are still in development, their availability and capabilities might change over time.

claims.claim: Business Analytics is a dedicated app aimed at business decision makers and general managers.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app has Overview, Use cases, Cost & forecast, Users & groups and service pages.
claims.quote: Overview; Use cases; Cost & forecast; Users & groups; Services pages (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Agents)

claims.claim: The app combines insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based services such as Cowork, agents and GitHub Copilot.
claims.quote: brings insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot, together in a single experience

claims.claim: Cost & forecast covers usage-based billing and excludes Microsoft Copilot user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.claim: The Overview page displays Microsoft 365 Copilot service cost as Included in license.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast page offers a base forecast.
claims.quote: Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast page offers a growth forecast.
claims.quote: Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: Forecast scenarios include a spend cap and changes to model mix.
claims.quote: Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap; Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A reporting budget target neither creates an enforced spending policy nor enforces a spending limit.
claims.quote: A reporting budget target helps you analyze spending. Creating the target doesn't configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison, not live policies, limits or access.
claims.quote: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison. It doesn't modify live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets, or user limits.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The cited AI value methodology estimates monetary value for Cowork.
claims.quote: This entire article applies to Cowork assisted hours and value, including customization. It does not apply to Copilot assisted hours and Copilot assisted value, including customization.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: AI value does not represent realised savings.
claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution. It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.

claims.claim: The app provides AI cost views by user, group and model.
claims.quote: The table shows each provider's Cost per user, Credits used, Cost (% of total cost), and Active users. Select the dropdown next to a provider to expand it and see the same metrics for each individual model.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Some people receive Business Analytics access automatically under the preview documentation.
claims.quote: Some people get access to Agent 365 Business Analytics automatically. Others need a Global admin to assign it.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated how the app will arrive for tenants at general availability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "default" "general availability". Opened introduction and manage/introduction; both describe Frontier preview access, not a general-availability rollout mechanism.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Copilot Credits limits are configured in Microsoft 365 admin center spending policies rather than in the analytics app.
claims.quote: Use the Cost Management dashboard in the Microsoft 365 admin center to enable usage-based billing, activate the default spending policy, create identity-based and resource-based spending policies.

claims.claim: Leaders in the top three organisation layers get tenant-level access in the preview.
claims.quote: The top three layers in the organization (CEO, their direct reports, and their next level of reports) get tenant-level access to the app.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Managers of teams meeting the documented minimum size of 10 get insights for their own organisation.
claims.quote: Managers of teams meeting the minimum group size of 10 can access insights for their own organization, including cost insights.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default in the preview.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default.

claims.claim: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.

claims.claim: An admin must turn consumption insights on for business leaders to see cost insights.
claims.quote: Cost, budget, and usage-based service insights appear only when consumption insights are turned on for your role. Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The permission set's Identification setting determines whether users see identifiable or de-identified data.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it. When identification is off, users see de-identified data instead.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast Users tab lists people with assigned usage limits when the viewer's role permits access.
claims.quote: The Users tab under Spending limits appears when user limits are assigned and your role permits access. The Users tab shows people who have an assigned usage limit.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Export is enabled by default, subject to access management.
claims.quote: Export is only available when it's enabled for employees using access management. It's enabled by default.

claims.claim: Available export options include CSV download.
claims.quote: CSV download: Create and download a file containing the selected service data

claims.claim: Available export options include an MCP connection.
claims.quote: MCP connection: View the setup information for making the service data available through an MCP connection

claims.claim: Include user identifiers is off by default for exports.
claims.quote: Because user identifiers are sensitive information, the setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Including user identifiers in exports depends on the viewer's permissions.
claims.quote: If you don't have permission to export identifiable information, the setting isn't displayed and the export uses anonymized identifiers.

claims.claim: Effective Business Analytics access combines all valid assignments, including security-group assignments.
claims.quote: A user can receive access from more than one source, such as a system-defined policy, a custom policy, or membership in a security group that's assigned to a policy. When this happens, the user's effective access is the combination of all of their valid assignments.

claims.claim: One Business Analytics access assignment never removes access another grants.
claims.quote: A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.claim: Spending policies are a prerequisite for usage-based services and their cost insights.
claims.quote: Spending policies for usage-based services must be set up for users to use these services and get cost insights.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Billing must be turned on in the Microsoft 365 admin center for usage-based service and agent metrics to appear.
claims.quote: The admin must turn on billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center for users to see usage-based services and agents metrics.

claims.claim: Some sections appear only when the necessary budget or limit data exists.
claims.quote: The Spending limits section appears only when at least one user limit or spending policy applies to the selected scope.

claims.quote: Calculator configurations apply at the tenant level.

claims.claim: Calculator changes affect dependent metrics and historical trends.
claims.quote: The changes also apply to dependent metrics and historical trends. For example, changing an assisted-hours input also changes assisted-value metrics that use those hours.

claims.claim: Calculator changes appear after the affected data, query or report refreshes.
claims.quote: Changes appear after the affected data, query, or report refreshes.

claims.claim: Previously completed queries and existing Interactive insights sessions are not recalculated automatically.
claims.quote: Previously completed queries and existing Interactive insights sessions aren't recalculated; rerun or refresh them to use the updated configuration.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure the time assumptions used in Cowork AI value estimates.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can configure the hourly-rate assumptions used in AI value estimates.
claims.quote: Hourly rate | Estimated hourly labor cost used to calculate AI value. Administrators can adjust this value to reflect their organization's labor-cost assumptions.

claims.claim: The Frontier preview requires at least 50 assigned Copilot licences in the tenant.
claims.quote: Tenant must have at least 50 Copilot licenses assigned.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The introduction does not specify a separate price for the app.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "license" "price" and "Agent 365 Business Analytics" licensing included license general availability price. Opened introduction and the Agent 365 service description; no separate Business Analytics app price was stated.

claims.claim: The app's general-availability licensing and pricing terms have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" licensing included license general availability price. Read introduction, Agent 365 service description and Agents page prerequisites; these do not state general-availability terms for the Business Analytics app.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are billed to the subscription selected in the billing method.
claims.quote: Copilot credits are billed to the subscription that you select in the billing method.

claims.claim: When that subscription's credits run out, usage automatically continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.
claims.quote: When credits run out for that subscription, usage automatically continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.claim: The app reports Microsoft AI credits and GitHub AI credits separately.
claims.quote: In the credits view, Microsoft AI credits and GitHub AI credits are shown separately.

claims.claim: The GitHub Copilot page's cost and credit information is for reference only.
claims.quote: Cost and credit information on this page is for reference only.

claims.claim: Microsoft directs readers to GitHub.com for official GitHub AI credit billing and budget setting.
claims.quote: For official billing and detailed charges for GitHub AI credits and budget setting, go to GitHub.com.

claims.claim: The cited Viva access-management controls are unavailable in GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD. For GCC (Government Community Cloud), see the documentation for your specific app for availability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explained how Business Analytics controls will behave in the roadmap's government clouds.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "GCC High" "controls" and "Business Analytics" "FeatureId" "GCC". Read feature-access-management, app management pages and supported-environments excerpts; none resolves future Business Analytics control behaviour in these clouds.

claims.claim: Insights analysts, Insights admins and leaders or GMs not detected automatically need access assigned by a Global admin.
claims.quote: Access assigned by a Global admin | - Insights analysts - Insights admins - Other leaders or GMs who aren't detected automatically

claims.claim: Global, AI and Viva Insights administrators can manage Business Analytics access policies.
claims.quote: The following admin roles can view and manage access policies, permission sets, and partitions in Business Analytics: Global administrator; AI administrator; Viva Insights administrator

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights role assignments and tenant minimum group size settings carry over.
claims.quote: Users inherit the access and organizational scope of their existing roles from Viva Insights; role assignments don't need to be renewed. In addition, existing tenant-level settings such as minimum group size carry over from Viva Insights

claims.claim: Business Analytics access management is reached through Manage > Access management.
claims.quote: In Business Analytics, on the left, under Manage, select Access management.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API is documented for the app's access policies, permission sets and partitions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "access policies" "PowerShell" API. Read manage/access, manage/introduction and viva/manage-access-policies; found app UI and separate VFAM automation, not an API for the app's permission-set/partition access policies.

claims.claim: Access uses permission sets, partitions and access policies, with Chief Officer, Group Manager and Analyst system permission sets.
claims.quote: Access in Business Analytics is built from three components: permission sets, partitions, and access policies. Three permission sets: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst.

claims.claim: The feature policy UI path is Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > On or Off.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy. Name the policy and select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId "Viva Insights web app", IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates the documented tenant disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant; ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : Viva Insights web app; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app feature control supports tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level using the Viva Insights web app feature access management control

claims.claim: The documents do not unambiguously confirm that the Viva Insights web app control switches Business Analytics off.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "FeatureId". Read manage/introduction, feature-access-management and manage-settings-copilot-dashboard: they refer to VFAM and say 'where applicable', without expressly mapping this app to the Viva Insights web app switch.

claims.claim: No Business Analytics-specific feature ID was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "FeatureId". Read manage/introduction, viva/feature-access-management, viva/manage-access-policies and manage-settings-copilot-dashboard; no feature ID named for Business Analytics was given.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights lists the available Viva Insights features and their IDs.
claims.quote: For example, to see which features are supported in Viva Insights, run the following cmdlet: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights

claims.claim: The Business Analytics admin introduction points to VFAM for turning the app on or off.
claims.quote: Manage other feature controls: turn the app on or off, publish reports, export data, Copilot assisted value, Copilot Chat in Viva Insights, and delegation | VFAM

claims.claim: The same admin introduction lists the exclusion list as managed through VFAM.
claims.quote: Manage the exclusion list | VFAM

claims.claim: The documented default-policy spending limit path is Copilot > Cost Management > Get Started > Activate the default spending policy for your organization > Set the monthly spending limit for this policy > Limit monthly spending.
claims.quote: go to Copilot and then the Cost Management node ... select Get Started ... Activate the default spending policy for your organization ... In the Set the monthly spending limit for this policy section ... Limit monthly spending

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} updates a spending policy.
claims.quote: Update a spendingPolicy object. PATCH /copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id}. PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/3f9e2c1a-0000-0000-0000-00000000c21b

claims.claim: The spending-policy update accepts periodLimit to configure a policy limit.
claims.quote: The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The spending-policy update accepts perUserLimit to configure a per-user limit.
claims.quote: "perUserLimit": { "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.limitedCostManagementQuantity", "value": 500, "unit": "copilotCredit" }

claims.claim: The spending-policy update accepts billingMethods to change funding.
claims.quote: Use this method to change updatable properties, including billingMethods.

claims.claim: Adding pay-as-you-go funding requires a complete billingInstrument.
claims.quote: When changing stored non-pay-as-you-go funding to include pay-as-you-go, supply a complete billingInstrument; no separate billing endpoint or action is used.

claims.claim: The update method does not define replacement of an existing pay-as-you-go instrument.
claims.quote: This method doesn't define instrument-only updates or replacement of an already-pay-as-you-go instrument.

claims.claim: The Cost Management API shown is a beta spending-policy API, not an app-settings API.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported. Create, read, update, and delete spending policies that cap Copilot Credits consumption for an audience.

claims.claim: The Cowork value visibility control is at Manage > Configurations > Metric calculators > Cowork assisted hours and value > Edit calculator > Value calculator > Value metrics.
claims.quote: under Manage, select Configurations ... Configurations > Metric calculators ... Under Cowork assisted hours and value, select Edit calculator. Select the Value calculator tab. On the right, use the Value metrics toggle

claims.claim: Cowork value metrics visibility is off by default.
claims.quote: Administrators can control whether AI value metrics for Cowork are displayed to users in their organization. This setting applies across the tenant and is turned off by default.

claims.claim: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.
claims.quote: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.

claims.claim: Copilot value metric configuration requires both Viva Insights admin and Chief officer roles, or Global admin.
claims.quote: Only users who have both Viva Insights admins and Chief officer roles, or who are global admins, can configure Copilot value metrics.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented PowerShell or an API for Business Analytics calculator and value-metric configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "calculator" "privacy" API PowerShell configuration; site:learn.microsoft.com/a365-business-analytics "PowerShell" "value". Read manage/configurations and manage/introduction; no calculator configuration operation found.

claims.claim: The minimum-group-size control is at Manage > Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size in Business Analytics.
claims.quote: To open the page in Business Analytics, on the left under Manage, select Configurations. Use the Privacy tab ... Minimum group size ... Enter a value of at least 5.

claims.claim: The tenant minimum group size hides smaller aggregated groups and must be at least 5.
claims.quote: Minimum group size is the minimum number of people that must be in a group before aggregated insights are shown. Enter a value of at least 5. Admins can manage minimum group size at the tenant level within privacy settings.

claims.claim: Minimum group size does not apply to nonaggregated user-level insights.
claims.quote: It doesn't apply to user-level insights that aren't aggregated.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API is documented for Business Analytics privacy settings, including minimum group size.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/a365-business-analytics "API" "minimum group size"; "Business Analytics" "calculator" "privacy" API PowerShell configuration. Read manage/configurations, manage/introduction and related Viva settings excerpts; no such operation found.

claims.claim: The Copilot Credits spending-policy row is not a GitHub spending control.
claims.quote: For official billing and detailed charges for GitHub AI credits and budget setting, go to GitHub.com.

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The low cost rating reflects known indirect administration effort, while no separate app price is specified.
claims.quote: Tenant must have at least 50 Copilot licenses assigned. Spending policies for usage-based services must be set up for users to use these services and get cost insights. Admins can assign access and set up partitions
claims.fix: Append this sentence to the cost rationale: "The app's inclusion or separate licensing terms are not yet published." This makes the rationale explicitly state the licensing uncertainty, as required by the cost scale; retain the documented 50-assigned-Copilot-licence prerequisite.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "default" "general availability". Read introduction, manage/introduction and manage/access; automatic preview access is documented, but no general-availability arrival/default commitment was found.
